modelVsIndividual.rule: Model-level facts are stored once and referenced by battery items; individual-battery facts must resolve to one exact physical battery and must not silently overwrite model facts.
modelVsIndividual.inheritance: item may read model data by reference; item-specific override requires an explicit legal/data-contract basis and provenance

uniqueIdentifier.uniquenessScope: global scheme namespace used by the responsible economic operator

rules: scan must resolve to the exact passport for the encoded unique identifier
must not rely on a generic marketing landing page
public access is free for public data
resolver changes must preserve identifier-to-passport continuity
repurposed/remanufactured successor passport must retain explicit link to original passport(s) where legally required
no lifecycle state may delete historical provenance

access.rule: server-side policy must enforce access; UI hiding is not evidence of access control

registryAdapter.externalDependency: live EU DPP Registry onboarding/credentials and test procedure

evidencePack.rule: missing external evidence keeps final EU conformance gate incomplete

finalGate.rule: system may report evidence state; it must not self-issue certification
